items.title: Approve the Minutes of the September 24, 2019 Meeting
Appoint Danielle Thoe to the Citizens Advisory Committee
Update on Caltrans U.S. 101 Deck Replacement at Alemany Circle Project
Accept the Downtown Rail Extension Peer Review Panel’s Final Report on Governance, Oversight, Management and Project Delivery
Allocate $24,253,024, with Conditions, and Appropriate $749,724 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds for 23 Requests
Adopt the SOMA Youth and Family Zone Community Engagement Final Report [NTIP Planning]
Approve San Francisco’s Program of Projects for the 2020 Regional Transportation Improvement Program
Approve Amendment No. 4 to the MOA with the TIDA for Yerba Buena Island Vista Point Operation Services
